chunks.text: A Barsa .metaexport file is GZip-compressed .NET BinaryFormatter output whose root object is a System.Data.DataSet, carried as an XSD string plus an XML DiffGram string. The XML declares utf-16 but the bytes are UTF-8.
chunks.title: Export package container format

chunks.text: BixHelper.Import(string, ImportOptions) is the façade; NewImportManager.Import(ImportOptions) is the engine. ImportOptions carries Simulate, IsClone, AddMissedReferences and writes back out_IdFixer and out_DataSet.
chunks.title: Import entry point

chunks.text: The package carries a $IdEmbeddingFields control table whose rows are (TableName, ColumnName, OperationalType, FieldType) with OperationalType in {pk, fk, idpattern}. FixIdForImport.Init/FixAll consume it. Whether a specific id survives unchanged is Unknown.
chunks.title: ID remapping on import

chunks.text: NewImportManager.Import invokes, in body order: DeserializeDataSetFromFile, FixIdForImport, clone fixups, ImportManager_Structure.AfterImport, ObjectReferenceBuilder.RecreateForAll, MissedReferenceFinder, then writes the import audit end timestamp. Per-table write order is Unknown.
chunks.title: Import stage order

chunks.text: BixHelper.Export(ObjectReferenceSelection, string, bool, int, bool) fronts NewExportManager.Export(MultiSubProgress, ObjectReferenceSelection, Action<ExportSaveContext>). The selection comes from the export tree via ExportDataSource : IActiveDataSource.
chunks.title: Export entry point

chunks.text: BixHelper.Clone runs Export then Import with ImportOptions.IsClone set, proving the format round-trips within the product. ImportCloneManager.GetFromNewIdMap(long) exposes the old-to-new id map.
chunks.title: Export and import round-trip

chunks.text: NewImportManager.GetImportData returns IActiveDataSource, the same interface the export tree consumes. ImportTreeForm renders it against DbDataSource.GetCurrentDb() with change icons, so a package can be diffed against the live system before applying.
chunks.title: Package preview before import

chunks.text: User-defined entities store rows in dyn_<n> and m0<n>_<name> tables with positional F1..Fn columns. $Data_TypeDefDbNames and $Data_FieldDefDbNames map TypeDef and FieldDef ids to those physical names. A reader must resolve through them rather than hard-coding table names.
chunks.title: Dynamic table naming

chunks.text: Barsa.Meta.DataExchange.dll has private and internal members renamed to #Xx identifiers. Public API names survive. Internal behaviour is therefore Unknown unless it is visible as a call edge to a named member.
chunks.title: DataExchange assembly is obfuscated

chunks.text: Whether import runs in a transaction and rolls back on failure could not be established. The confirmation dialog warns that without a backup there is no way back, which is suggestive but is a UI string, not proof.
chunks.title: Import atomicity is unresolved

scope.note: Bulk indexes (types, methods, properties, fields, references) cover Barsa-owned assemblies only. Third-party assemblies are inventoried in assemblies.json with full counts but not indexed member-by-member.
